free.reference: Free deployed actor, discounted100-step return, no forced action or terminal bootstrap

adjusted_decisions.scope: Forced single action followed by own actor; candidates include own actor slot0

q.band_boundary: abs(a0)<=.25 inclusive; fixed slots2,3,4, not strictly interior
q.independent_unit: Training seed; states/episodes nested, six candidates not independent

raw_decisions.scope: Forced single action followed by own actor; candidates include own actor slot0

q.reference: Each model own deterministic actor continuation; Qpi, no Qstar or common-policy claim

all.scope: Signed advantage under own continuation policy; no assumption that a withheld action is inferior

high_load_hole.scope: Signed advantage under own continuation policy; no assumption that a withheld action is inferior

low_load_retained_band.scope: Signed advantage under own continuation policy; no assumption that a withheld action is inferior

visited.mechanism_scope: Hole entry does not establish critic exploitation; symmetric-tail squared BC itself favors zero
visited.reference: Exact discounted suffix of the same deterministic free trajectory, finite horizon, zero terminal bootstrap
visited.support_scope: Known withholding mask only. State typicalness and joint four-action support at these visited rows are unmeasured.
